[[File:Keren_map.png|thumb|A map showing the Industrial District]]
The '''Industrial District''' was an urban area located within the central [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the second largest settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The district bordered the [[Mercantile District]] and the residential areas, while facing [[Lake Varum]].
